title: History: every run with its source, changes, players and output
covers: History screen: list, filters, detail, Run again, Clean old runs
context: History is its own screen after Sessions. Each run shows the session it came from, the changes it ran with, who played and its seed and files. The filters narrow the list by session, status and date, and the page filter by text. Run again with this config opens a new tab. Clean old runs removes runs older than 30 days.
changed: views/History: list, filters, detail sections, RunActions
runs: source, overrides and players recorded on each run

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: runs
setup.text: At least two stopped runs of one session, one of them started with Run once with these changes (see the test Sessions: Run). Make them first if History is empty.

steps: Open History in the sidebar (just under Sessions The list shows runs newest first: session name, date, status and the seed, with a chip such as The header has the filter Filter runs, three selects and the button Clean old runs.

Pick the run made with Run once. The detail is titled Run of and the date, with the status. Sections run in order: Source (a button with the session name), Changes for this run (a table Setting, Saved, Ran with), Players, Config and Output.

In Players each row shows the slot, the name, the game and an origin tag: Saved, Added in lobby or Joined (a joined player also shows its client and trust). Output shows the seed and the buttons Open files and Show log. Press Show log.
Pick a run made with plain Run. Changes for this run reads Ran as saved. No setting was changed for this run.

Use the selects: Filter by session, Filter by status (All statuses, Hosting, Stopped, Failed) and Filter by date (Any date, Last 7, 30, 90 days The list narrows Type in Filter runs: it narrows A nonsense word reads No run matches.

Press Open session: Sessions opens on the source session. Go back to History and press Run again with this config on the run made with Run once. A new tab opens in the Lobby phase and its tag reads 1 change from saved.
Press Delete on an old run and confirm. The run leaves the list. Delete is off for a run that still hosts, where the button Go to its tab shows instead.
Look at Clean old runs. It is greyed out when no run is older than 30 days. If some are, it asks first with the count and says the output files go too.
pass: The list is newest first with a chip for the source and its changes.
The detail shows Source, Changes for this run, Players with origin tags, Config and Output, in that order.
The filters and the text filter narrow the list. Run again with this config opens a new tab with the same changes.
Delete and Clean old runs ask first, and Delete is off for a live run.
fail: A run lists no source or the changes are wrong.
A filter does nothing, or the text filter hides everything.
Run again hosts a room at once, or opens a tab without the changes.
Delete removes a run with no question.
notes: An old run made before this version has no recorded source. It reads Source matched by name or the source is unknown. That is not a failure.
A run whose session was deleted shows Session deleted and Run again is off with a sentence.
